title: Ticket Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A kind of air ticket — the employee's own, or one for a kind of dependant — and how its entitlement builds up and lapses. Ticket type 1 is the employee's own ticket; the others are dependant tickets. How many tickets and their value are set per sub group.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: TicketBasisPeriod
fields.rules: Required. One of: Calendar Days, Fixed Days.
fields.html:
What it is. Whether a ticket's value is based on calendar days or a fixed number of days.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: TicketBasisFixedDays
fields.html:
What it is. The fixed number of days, for the fixed-days basis.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: Lapse
fields.html:
What it is. Whether unused ticket entitlement lapses.

Why it matters. Ticked, the ticket entitlement runs in cycles of Lapse After years from the start of its accrual period, and starts again each cycle. Unticked, the first cycle never ends.

fields.label: LapseAfter
fields.html:
What it is. How many years each ticket cycle lasts before unused entitlement lapses.

Example. 2
fields.adminHtml: With Lapse ticked, this must be at least 1; the form refuses 0 and shows an error. A ticket type saved with 0 before this rule existed is calculated as 1 year, so check any old ticket types that have Lapse ticked.

fields.label: StopDependantAccrualAfter
fields.html:
What it is. When dependant ticket accrual stops.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: MinCompensation
fields.html:
What it is. The least paid when a ticket is compensated in cash.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: DeductionPeriod
fields.rules: Required. One of: After Entitlement, Same As Entitlement.
fields.html:
What it is. Whether a used ticket is taken from the current or the next entitlement.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: QuotaEntitlement
fields.html:
What it is. Whether tickets build up over the period or are available straight away.

Example. Period

Why it matters. Period makes the time engine accrue the entitlement a little each day. Immediate accrues nothing day by day.

fields.label: WageTypeId
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Wagetype master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wagetype for this ticket type.

Example. Air Ticket

Why it matters. It must be filled in to save, but nothing reads it at present.
